# Stargazer

The same occupation in English: the captions from the `en` table, the
English original hidden because the card is English. The deck prints
`de` and leaves it out. Invented for this deck — no row of any published
table.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: dcc
  card-type: occupation
  language: en
data:
  name: Stargazer
  original-name: Stargazer
  roll: "07"
  roll-min: 7
  roll-max: 7
  description: "Reads in the stars what others read in their beer — and is wrong less often."
  trained-weapon: Staff (1d4)
  trade-goods: Star chart
  reference: Core Rulebook p. 26
```
